dependencies.name: Godot Engine
dependencies.notes: Free/open source. Pin engine version and ship Godot/third-party notices before production.

dependencies.name: Phantom Camera
dependencies.compatibility: Godot 4; current Asset Library release 0.11.0.3 targets Godot 4.4
dependencies.risk: Current Asset Store release marked unstable; use stable GitHub/AssetLib release appropriate to pinned engine, never main branch.

dependencies.name: Dialogue Manager
dependencies.compatibility: Use Dialogue Manager v3.3 for Godot 4.3; v3.10 for 4.4/4.5; v4 for 4.6+.
dependencies.risk: Do not install latest blindly; version must match pinned Godot.

dependencies.name: GDrama
dependencies.compatibility: Godot 4; HTML5 demo exists; Asset Library v1.1.1.
dependencies.risk: Potential overlap with Dialogue Manager/JakeAI Scene Director. Evaluate architecture before adopting to avoid redundant dependencies.

dependencies.name: LimboAI
dependencies.purpose: agent/NPC behavior trees and state machines
dependencies.compatibility: v1.2.0-v1.3.x for Godot 4.3; v1.6.x for 4.4/4.5; Web export supported by Godot 4.3 GDExtension release.
dependencies.risk: Demo artwork has separate CC BY 4.0 terms and must not be silently incorporated. Current Asset Store release is marked unstable; pin a stable compatible release.

hard_rule: No dependency becomes APPROVED-PINNED until automated Web/mobile smoke tests pass and all required license notices are captured.
